title: Trust store CoAP resource: read/write CA roots
description: Implement the trust store as a CoAP resource per spec §8.13. Resource path: /.well-known/trust-anchors (or similar). Operations: GET (list trusted CA roots), POST (add a CA root — guarded by authorization), DELETE (remove a CA root). Each entry: DER-encoded X.509 CA cert or raw Ed25519 pubkey + metadata. Must support: pre-configured roots (built into firmware), runtime-added roots (via LCI/provisioning), cross-signed roots. Python reference impl first, then Rust, then C stub. Integrates with existing TrustStore in python/src/lichen/crypto/trust.py (currently TOFU-only, needs CA chain level).
close_reason: Python reference impl landed: lichen.crypto.trust_anchors (TrustAnchorStore keyed by issuer IID; raw Ed25519 + X.509 DER CA anchors; cross-signed same-key cert attachment incl. provisioned anchors; bounds MAX_ANCHORS=64/MAX_CERTS_PER_ANCHOR=8/MAX_CERT_DER_BYTES=1024/MAX_METADATA_ENTRIES=8/MAX_METADATA_BYTES=256) + TrustAnchorsResource at /.well-known/trust-anchors (GET open; POST/DELETE guarded by injected authorize over OSCORE-bound identity, fail-closed; strict per-path field sets) + build_site wiring (trust_anchor_store/trust_anchor_authorize params, tunnel_auth pattern). 42 tests green; ruff+mypy clean; full tests/coap suite 1900 passed (edhoc_responder failure pre-existing on clean HEAD). 3x reviewer-model codereview converged after fixing 10 findings across 4 rounds. Cert chain validation is viku.6 scope (documented). Follow-ups: 5hbz (Rust port), ri1f (C stub + NVS persistence).
